desc:
💰 Welcome to Own a Pawn Shop! Haggle with sellers, bid on storage auctions and sell your finds for a profit!

🤝 BUY LOW: Sellers bring everything from $8 toasters to gold bars. Haggle them down, but inspect first: some lie!
🏷️ SELL HIGH: Price your shelves and haggle with buyers.
🔦 LOCKUPS: Peek into storage units with a flashlight, outbid Big Earl and see what's under the tarp!
⭐ 170+ items, Common to Legendary, up to a $550,000 holo card.
🏗️ GROW: Expand, add glass cases, hire staff and unlock something new every level.
👥 6 shops, 1 street: shop at your neighbors' and bid against them.
🎁 Free cash every day you play!

From junk to gold bars: how rich can your shop get? 💸

🎮 Play on PC, phone, tablet and console.
👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for new updates!
